You must be running client version 1.109 or earlier in order to play. See this post in our forums: http://www.dolserver.net/viewtopic.php?f=6&t=20643 D2 has a quest driven storyline much like Diablo II, with a few twists thrown in for fun. Players are required to defeat a boss at the end of each Act in order to advance to the next Act. news: 1 decade ago: We merged the server with Curse Bleeding and now the name is Curse League PvP/RvR | 1 decade ago: Zehlys has registered a new server 'League PvP' on DAOC Portal!
description: Read the actual news here on Curse League! RvR Server information: We thought, we are close to a team on 2 servers distributed together. There is a "Curse League" RvR and a "Curse League" PvP. Admins of this server are Xanthron & Zehly. Xanthron will lead the RvR server and Zehly the PvP. The server name will be relatively the same except for the designation RvR and PvP so let's not confuse you. The server will run on two different MySQL server. We offer you the possibility to use two bug-free server to play. RvR Game Server informations: The RvR servers will have TNN, Camelot and Jordheim as setup zone. From there you have access to various NPC's and access to solo as well as group quests. The first level zone is Typhon's Reach including Ashen Isles. We want to give you the opportunity, to level from different level spots in the whole map (RvR or Typhons Reach + Ashen Isles), but caution, there is also RvR area so take care! You need to level from 40 to 50 , but we add quests for you, to get more easier leveling and you just benefit from it, because there are special rewards, each quest. This concept can be changed. { If you killed the gatekeeper infront of Volcanus Deep Dungeon, the door opens and u can pass for slayn the Mob Boss. There is a quest included, so after killing the boss mob, you will get a Magical Scroll, whichwill teleport u back to city for get the next step of the quest. The next step will be killing Apocalyptica on a Tower and of course you will get a scroll, Which teleports you to this region. That is the first concept and this can be changed all the time. Thats just a little Idea of what this looks like PvE. } The RvR is available at lvl 45-50 and the RvR zone will be Braemar. This zone will have custom Keeps and Towers for more RvR Fun and maybe a good Invention for getting people in RvR. So what we want to do, We have different tokens on this server Which can be farmed or get by killing people. Tokens: Challenger Token: This token drops after killing the Boss mobs and killing people in RvR. You can buy Challenger Tokens for BP but it would waste much bps. One Token will cost 50bps. (ML Token Merchant: ML1 cost 150 Challenger Tokens) Challenger Tokens are needed for buying ML tokens and getting MLs. Atlantean Glass (Artifacts): You can buy Artifacts with Atlantean Glass, and it is also buyable like Challenger tokens but they Are a lot cheaper than Challenger tokens. They will just cost 10 BPs. (Artifact Merchants: 1 Artifact cost 1000 Atlantean Glass) The Atlantean Glass can be farmed on the Level Map(Typhons Reach + Ashen Isles) from all mobs. Dragon Scales: These Scales are needed to buy Dragonslayer Stuff and Dragon Items like "Soul glimmer" ... They can be farmed at the Dragonsworn Spot over the whole map in Typhon's Reach and Ashen Isles. The Dragonsworns will be also Implemented in the RvR zone, so people have more possibilities to farm those scales or other stuff. Some Extras: * Potion Merchants, are buyable at the Bartender or other NPC´s in one House in the City. * Poison Merchants, are somewhere in a House. * Legendary Weapons like Benthic Weapons are added in Throne Room ... * Fixed Astral Weapons and Armor * Effect NPC´s, are somewhere in a House. * Custom Poison will be included like (Small AoE Ench Bomb Poison For Example) * we've created specific Trainers for all classes. * A Timer Teleporter which casts 3x. The first is HEY, LOOK AT ME AND COME TO ME! The second is HEY, ARE U READY FOR PORT? COME CLOSER! The third is I WISH YOU GOOD LUCK! After the third cast, you get ported from the City to Typhon's Reach to your Setup Zone. So if you see the teleporter like you know from the city, so they port you back to City or port you to Typhon's Reach Setup Zone. * Teleporters to RvR Zone are added Our team consists of 5 people: David, Supporter Zania, Gamemaster Lucy, Head-Gamemaster Zehly, PvP Server Administrator Xanthron, RvR Server Administrator ------------------------------- PvP Server Informations: Since we had many successful but also less successful PvP server , I was thinking about something special. There will be a Ranked-System that looks as follows: RR 1L0-2L9 Bronze RR 3L0-4L9 Silver RR 5L0-7L9 Gold RR 8L0-10L9 Platinum RR 11L0-12L9 Mithril RR 13L0 Diamond In addition, you will need to know which league you are or in which league you play, because Merchants will look which League you are playing and additional to that the NPC's or Merchants will be available to the specific League. Small example: A "Bronze" player has not the authority to access a Diamond NPC. no Dragonslayer armor can define, since it is intended for players Diamond (Diamond players can buy). - So, you play up to become the best! Become a member of a guild in order to show people that your guild is the most valuable! * Shows in epic guilds fight that your guild is the best! "Guild Fights need to be accepted by Zehly, and then you have the opportunity to prove you! - You will take the Chance?" Your Curse League Team - Zehly & Xanthron

description: Titan is planned to be a PvP server in the style of Mordred, but with some modern improvements. - Players will be able to group with any class from any realm, and be able to attack any target not in their group or guild as though they were a realm enemy. - All atlas orb costs will be converted to BP costs - Tir Na Nog, Jordheim, and Camelot are the only safe zones where players may not be attacked - Removal of conquest system, and rework of predator/bounty as solo activities for pvp ruleset - Various class and mechanic tweaks (detailed in a section below) Read the full server settings at: https://www.opendaoc.com/wiki/titan
